$comment: Tolerance policy of the Secrets quality gate: one entry per tolerated finding, identified by commit, file, rule, line and column. Changed only by a reviewed change that the adoption criteria approve; no run writes it. Every entry is a security finding and carries the explicit human decision that tolerates it.

entries.decision: Maintainer decision (adoption interview, 2026-11-21): synthetic test fixture or public SSH host-key fingerprint from a disposable VM, no credential; kept in history.
